purpose: Settings for stage 2 (the thesis). Decision record: docs/decisions/2026-11-18-stage-2-anchored-bearings.md.
guidance_tolerance_note: A single guided figure within this percentage of the consensus figure counts as in line. A guided range is in line when it contains the consensus figure (operator ruling, 19 November 2026).
results_tolerance_note: A reported figure within this percentage of its consensus estimate counts as in line. A display definition, not a tuned parameter.
